variables.name: EMBED_API_URL
variables.description: Origin of your hosted embed/stream API (e.g., https://your-api.koyeb.app). Leave empty to use the default Koyeb URL.

variables.name: PROXY_SECRET
variables.description: Secret key for signing proxy URLs. Set to any random string (e.g., my-secret-key-123). Required in production.

variables.name: WEB_DOMAIN
variables.description: Your site's full URL (e.g., https://your-app.railway.app). Used for CORS lockdown. Optional.
